surface: Showcase Network capture → Save pattern → Patterns replay
reproduction: Capture two JSON fetch responses with distinct URLs on an interactive page.
Search the captured list for the content type json, select one response, select its array key path, and save the pattern.
Reopen the saved pattern and rerun it on the same page while the selected request fires.
expected: The saved request matcher targets the selected response URL including query and path identity, independent of the list search. Rerun reloads the open page and extracts the selected JSON path when that request fires; a search change cannot silently switch the selected response.
actual: Source before repair saves the display search term json as config.url_filter. The runner matches that filter against request URLs only, so a URL without json cannot match and the rerun times out. Selection is also an index into the filtered list, so changing the search can silently point Save at a different response. Installed-extension reproduction remains pending.
severity: S2: a saved recipe can fail to recapture the selected data or silently target another response
